ACOUSTIC WOODBLOCKS — LOW AND HIGH

Both source recordings are CC0-1.0. Full license: ../CC0-1.0.txt.

LOW
Versilian Community Sample Library (VCSL), Versilian Studios LLC.
Source: https://versilian-studios.com/vcsl/
File: Idiophones/Struck Idiophones/Woodblock/wood_click_f_rr1.wav
Pinned repository commit: c1ea7bcc3c7309650ab0da9d15c9cd1fbc4a4c7e
Original 44.1 kHz, 24-bit stereo recording.

HIGH
Block "Meinl" in wood (#0466), Joseph SARDIN / BigSoundBank.
Source: https://bigsoundbank.com/block-meinl-in-wood-s0466.html
Original WAV: https://bigsoundbank.com/UPLOAD/bwf-en/0466.wav
Original 48 kHz, 16-bit mono studio recording; one isolated hit extracted.
The publisher permits commercial use, editing and redistribution in apps.

Native pitches preserved. Quiet lead and tails trimmed; constant gain used
to balance levels. High voice gently high-passed at 100 Hz to remove
handling rumble and resampled to 44.1 kHz. Short endpoint fades, TPDF
dither, and 16-bit PCM output. Source channel counts preserved.
No synthetic layers, temple-block reuse, pitch shifting or compression.

Exact source and output hashes, excerpts and processing: PROVENANCE.json.
Reproducible preparation: scripts/prepare-woodblock.py; source selection:
scripts/woodblock-sources.json.
